description: Source code for the Microchip KSZ8081 Ethernet PHY driver in Zephyr RTOS, including register access, link management, autonegotiation, and configuration functions.

methods.name: phy_mc_ksz8081_read
methods.description: Reads a register from the KSZ8081 PHY via MDIO.

methods.name: phy_mc_ksz8081_write
methods.description: Writes a value to a register in the KSZ8081 PHY via MDIO.

methods.name: phy_mc_ksz8081_autonegotiate
methods.description: Initiates autonegotiation process on the PHY.

methods.name: phy_mc_ksz8081_get_link
methods.description: Retrieves current link status and speed from the PHY.

methods.name: phy_mc_ksz8081_static_cfg
methods.description: Sets static configuration registers for the PHY based on device tree properties.

methods.name: phy_mc_ksz8081_cfg_link
methods.description: Configures link speed and restarts autonegotiation.

methods.name: phy_mc_ksz8081_link_cb_set
methods.description: Sets callback for link status changes.

methods.name: phy_mc_ksz8081_monitor_work_handler
methods.description: Periodic work handler to monitor link status changes.

methods.name: phy_mc_ksz8081_init
methods.description: Initializes the PHY device, including GPIO reset and work setup.
